stc.tutorial.title: Tutorial
stc.tutorial.intro.title: How do I play this mod?
stc.tutorial.intro.body:
This mod brings Slay the Spire style card combat into Minecraft.
You fight with cards in hand, and every enemy shows what it will do next above its head.

First time? Follow this order:
1. Craft a Card Binder and a Spire Gate (recipes below).
2. Hold the Card Binder in your main or off hand, then right-click the Spire Gate.
3. Click a character card to read its details, then click "Select this character" - you get a starting deck and a starter relic.
4. Spawn a mob nearby (e.g. /summon minecraft:zombie) and right-click it with the Battle Standard to start a fight.
5. Click your cards to play them; clear the enemies to earn a card reward.

Card Binder recipe: leather x3 / string, wool, string / leather x3.
Spire Gate recipe: stone bricks, glass, stone bricks / glass, diamond, glass / stone bricks, glass, stone bricks.
Battle Standard recipe: wool / stick / stick (one vertical column).
stc.tutorial.combat.title: Combat basics
stc.tutorial.combat.body:
Each turn: energy refills (3 by default) -> you draw -> you play cards -> enemies act one by one.

Block: incoming damage hits your block first, and only the overflow costs HP. Your block is cleared at the start of your turn.
"Damage" can be blocked; "lose HP" cannot (burn, decay and poison executions all go through it).

Common statuses:
- Strength: +1 attack damage per stack
- Weak: stacks, -1 attack damage per stack (never expires); cancels out Strength
- Mining Fatigue: stacks, -25% attack damage per stack (counts down)
- Vulnerable: incoming damage +25%
- Dexterity / Slow: block gained +1 / -1 (they cancel each other out)

HP: your spire HP is separate (75 by default). It is unaffected by your vanilla health bar and persists between fights.
Clear the enemies to win; at 0 HP you die through the vanilla flow and restart from floor 1.

Press R or click "End Turn" to pass; "Abandon" leaves the fight (it kills you).
stc.tutorial.spire.title: Climbing the spire
stc.tutorial.spire.body:
The spire has three floors, and each floor's goal is to defeat its boss.
Bosses are not spawned for you - you have to find them:
- Floor 1: Breeze / Evoker / Sniffer
- Floor 2: Zoglin / Panda / Elder Guardian
- Floor 3: Ender Dragon / Wither / Warden

Every floor has its own mob pool: mobs from other floors will not start a fight.
To see what you can fight here, open the Spire Gate and click "View this floor's targets".

There are four event types, each with a per-floor cap:
- Normal fights 15 - Elites 5 - Campfires 5 - Question events 5
(Boss fights do not consume the cap.)

Campfire: hold the Card Binder in your off hand plus Flint and Steel in your main hand, then right-click a lit campfire to heal or to forge (upgrade) a card.

Every win grants gold and a card choice; beating a floor boss takes you to the next floor.
stc.tutorial.binder.title: Using the Card Binder
stc.tutorial.binder.body:
The Card Binder is the core item, but it stores nothing itself - your cards, gold and HP live in your player profile, so every binder shows the same data.

How to carry it: holding it in your main or off hand counts. With Curios installed you can also put it in a charm slot.

How to open it: press B, right-click the binder, or click "View Card Binder" at the Spire Gate.
Opening the UI does not require holding it, but starting a fight does.

What is inside:
- Cards you own: browse everything, click for details
- Relics you own: what you have and what it does
- Event/turn stats: per-floor counters, target boss, win/loss record
- Codex: cards / relics / statuses / potions / enemy factions

Upgrading cards: campfire "Forge", the Weaponsmith event, or /stc binder upgrade.
stc.tutorial.codex.title: Codex, rewards and commands
stc.tutorial.codex.body:
Rewards: every win immediately offers a choice of three cards; bosses always offer a rare (top tier) card.

Kill thresholds: killing the same mob type enough times grants an extra reward (60 normal / 30 elite).

Card Master shop: let an unemployed villager walk next to a Spire Gate and it becomes a Card Master.
Right-click it to buy cards, relics and potions, or to pay for card removal.

Useful commands (all start with /stc):
- /stc binder status - your profile
- /stc combat status - the current fight
- /stc progress show - floor and progress
- /stc binder upgrade - upgrade a card

Press B, then "Codex", to read details for any card, relic or status.
